MALAYSIA ACT

MODIFICATION OF Laws (EMPLOYMENT INFORMATION) (EXTENSION TO
Borneo STATES) ORDER, 1967

25 of 7903.    In exercise of the powers conferred by section 74 of the Malaysia Act,
the Yang di-Perluan Agong hereby makes the following Order:

Citntion.      1. This Order may be cited as the Modification of Laws (Employment
Information) (Extension to Borneo States) Order, 1967.

Extension     2. (1) The Employment Information Ordinance, 1953 (hereinafter called

33 of 1953.    "the extended Ordinance') is extended to the Borneo States.

(2) In the application of the extended Ordinance to the Borneo
States—

(a) for the definition of "Commissioner" in section 2 there shall be
substituted the following definition:

"Commissioner" means the Commissioner for Labour and all
Deputy Commissioners and Assistant Commissioners appomted

Sabah Cap. 67        under the Labour Ordinance of Sabah or of Sarawak, ag the
Cap. 76.             case may be;

(b) there shall be inserted in section 2, after the definition of
"Commissioner", the following definition:

"Labour Officer' means any officer appointed under the
Labour Ordinance of Sabah or of Sarawak, as the case may
be, for the purpose of carrying out the provisions of that
Ordinance;";

(c) references in the extended Ordinance to any written law in force
in the States of Malaya or any part thereof shall—

(i) if such written law has been extended to apply to Sabah
or Sarawak, as the case may be, be construed as
references to such written law as so extended; or

(ii) if such written law has not been so extended, be construed
as references to the corresponding written law, if any, in
force in Sabah or Sarawak, as the case may be.

Made this 23rd day of January, 1967.
(AG. 3375 SF. 143.1

By Command,

TAN Sri ABDUL JAMIL BIN ABDUL Rals,
Secretary to the Cabinet
